title: Higher education funding in the US: A broad overview
paragraphs: It also will help journalists better understand the impacts of thefederal funding cuts President Donald Trump has orderedin recent months and the additional changes he wants to make at the U.S. Department of Education. On Friday, the White House released Trump’sfederal budget proposal for fiscal year 2026, which calls for cutting hundreds of millions of dollars in funding for colleges, universities and their students.

Federal student aid faces major cuts, however, under President Trump. His new budget proposal slashes $980 million from theFederal Work-Study program, which provides part-time jobs for college students who have demonstrated they need more financial assistance.
